'''2007 Ohio State Championship Cedric Simon LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cedric Simon]] at [[2007 Ohio State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Watch Your Couch
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
